installation.action: Inspect five pads and raised supports; no removable bottom plate is required.

Rear switch first. Enter through the open nose, temporarily inboard and raised; follow the staged routes in insertion_checks.json. Lower into the open socket, slide its removable clamp from the front, then fit its M2 hardware.

Middle switch enters from the nose 4 mm raised, then lowers its terminals through the tray. Main switches descend along the 18 degree tilted socket normal. Fit two M2 x 12 bolts, two washers and one nut per bolt.

Preassemble encoder and wheel outside body. Slide from the open nose 0.4 mm above its final level, lower, then insert the 2 mm hinge pin from the right-hand side; the left-side clamps obstruct the opposite insertion direction.

Main keys enter from above 3 mm forward, lower to 5 mm above the final height, then move diagonally rearward/down into the hinge. Fit hinge pins from each outer side. Side keys enter from the exterior, followed by vertical 1.5 mm capture pins. Retain pin ends using a removable adhesive spot outside all bearings; no permanent clip grooves are designed.
Fit measured electronic board/adaptors to four local M2 slots; keep sensor downward view unobstructed and set measured lens height. Electronics and adaptor are not included as verified donor parts.
Affix five PTFE pads after confirming coplanarity; calibrate key stops and test return motion before powering.

hardware_limitations: Original Fenrir Pro PCB, sensor lens, battery and charging circuit have not been measured or verified.
Alps EC10E1220505 geometry and pin pattern use its public outline drawing, not formal supply specifications or a measured sample.
Integral PLA 1.67 mm AF encoder hex drive needs a torsion/fit coupon; a machined metal drive shaft is advised if long-term durability is required.
Five D2F sockets use explicit M2 bolts, washers and nuts. Actual switch travel, wire exit and printed fits must still be calibrated on the purchased components.
No universal claim of safe switch overtravel: supplied gaps/stops are geometric starting values; shim contact height to actual PT/OP before use.

wheel.installation: Preassemble on bench; insert integral hex driver along X into encoder rotor, then fit rear click hinge. Pin dimensions are not scaled.

encoder_board.source: Proposed custom adapter with edge relief; not a purchased PCB.
